name: Bona Film Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Bona Film Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in film investment, production, and distribution in China and internationally. It operates through Movies, Episode, Cinema and Theater Chains, AI-Generated Film and Television Dramas, and Other segments. The company is also involved in unified branding, film scheduling, operation, and management of cinemas; and the creation, investment, and distribution of web series, television dramas, and micro short dramas.
